title: check-vi-mock-inherit test: three cases scan the whole repository inside their 15 s budget (same timeout shape as #27423)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXpF772qWJjojJvRXw

Follow-up from p0 #27423 (PR #27437, os-dev report 6490189677).

## What happens

`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` has the same shape #27423 fixed in `check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`: three cases each run a whole-repository scan inside their own case, measured at 6.1–6.8 s each. On a loaded CI shard that sits close to the 15 s test budget. A main-red timeout like #27423's (`Test UI` shard, green on the same sha in the queue) is the expected failure mode.

## Fix shape (reuse #27437)

- Take each whole-repository reading once per file, at collection (in the `describe` body, not in a case or a `beforeAll`, per `ui/AGENTS.md` 测试纪律), through a frozen memo, so no case walks the repo.
- Never raise a timeout, skip, retry or change an assertion.

## Acceptance

- No case in the file runs a whole-repository scan, and the three cases each run in milliseconds.
- Every assertion is unchanged, and the file stays green.
- Report before and after timings for the three cases and for the file, idle and under CPU load.
